Venezia vs. Inter will take place at 5.30pm GMTon Wednesday, October 28,in Serie A.

Fans watching in Canada can catch the game at 1.30pmET   and 10.30am PT.

 Date: Wednesday, October 28
 Kick-off: 5.30pm GMT / 1.30pm ET / 10.30am PT

The fixture will take place at the Stadio Pier Luigi Penzo in Venice.

## Venezia vs. Inter team news

### Venezia

Captain Gianluca Busio could return to the squad, but the hosts are still without Marin Sverko, Bartol Franjic and Andrea Adorante. [...] Previous XI: Stankovic, Halhal, Moreno, Juan, Hainaut, Haps, Basic, Sohm, Perez, Yeboah, Adams (vs Genoa, October 25)

### Inter

Inter are still missing Luis Henrique, Benjamin Pavard, John Stones and Curtis Jones, while Marcus Thuram could be rested in favour of Ange Bonny.

Previous XI: Provdel, Bisseck, Akanji, Bastoni, Diouf, Barella, Calhanoglu, Mkhitaryan, Augusto, Thuram, Esposito (vs Fiorentina, October 25)

 They'll take some heart, though, in knowing their only victory did come via a home win against Napoli, so could they cause an even bigger upset here?
